label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.7 a.1 co: What is its own subsistent being is INFINITE_1
locator: I q.7 a.1 co.: Cum igitur esse divinum non sit esse receptum in aliquo, sed ipse sit suum esse subsistens
interpretation: Form not received in matter has infinity in the sense of perfection, and being itself is what is most formal of all; since the divine being is not received in anything but is its own subsistent being, God is infinite and perfect. 'Not received in anything' is read through q.3 a.4 as the identity of essence and act of being; the reading states the general principle, not the application to God.
